description: This file defines a TeamRepository class with methods for managing team and organization data using Prisma ORM, including fetching, deleting, and permission checks, along with related type definitions and utility functions.

classes.name: TeamRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing team and organization data, including CRUD operations, membership management, and permission checks.

methods.name: findById
methods.description: Finds a team by its ID and returns parsed team data.

methods.name: findByIdIncludePlatformBilling
methods.description: Finds a team by ID including platform billing info.

methods.name: findAllByParentId
methods.description: Finds all teams with a specific parent ID.

methods.name: findByIdAndParentId
methods.description: Finds a team by ID and parent ID.

methods.name: findFirstBySlugAndParentSlug
methods.description: Finds a team by slug and parent slug.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a team by ID, including related event types and memberships.

methods.name: findTeamWithMembers
methods.description: Finds a team with its members and their acceptance status.

methods.name: findTeamsByUserId
methods.description: Finds teams associated with a user, optionally including organizations.

methods.name: findOwnedTeamsByUserId
methods.description: Finds teams where the user is an owner or admin, excluding organizations.

methods.name: findTeamWithOrganizationSettings
methods.description: Finds a team with its parent organization settings.

methods.name: findParentOrganizationByTeamId
methods.description: Finds the parent organization of a team.

methods.name: findOrganizationSettingsBySlug
methods.description: Finds organization settings by organization slug.

methods.name: findTeamSlugById
methods.description: Retrieves the slug of a team by its ID.

methods.name: findTeamWithParentHideBranding
methods.description: Finds branding visibility settings for a team and its parent.

methods.name: findOrganization
methods.description: Finds an organization associated with a team or user.

methods.name: findOrganizationIdBySlug
methods.description: Retrieves organization ID by slug.

methods.name: isSlugAvailableForUpdate
methods.description: Checks if a slug is available for update, avoiding conflicts.

methods.name: getTeamByIdIfUserIsAdmin
methods.description: Retrieves team info if the user is an admin or owner.

methods.name: findOrgTeamsExcludingTeam
methods.description: Finds organization teams excluding a specific team.

methods.name: findTeamsForCreditCheck
methods.description: Finds teams for credit check by IDs.

methods.name: findTeamMembersWithPermission
methods.description: Retrieves users with specific permissions within a team, considering PBAC and legacy roles.

methods.name: parsePermission
methods.description: Parses a permission string into resource and action components.

methods.name: findTeamsNotBelongingToOrgByIds
methods.description: Finds teams not belonging to a specific organization ID.

methods.name: findByIdsAndOrgId
methods.description: Finds teams by IDs and organization ID.

methods.name: findTeamBySlugWithAdminRole
methods.description: Finds a team by slug where the user has admin or owner role.
